cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're retiring 'fine' tonight. Send the awkward message you deleted; I'll make sure we can say things like that to each other.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then send one sentence. No explanation required. I'll take it seriously, and we can leave the rest until you're ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You first. You always sound so casual.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, I'll open: I check for your reply before I get out of bed. That's my one sentence. Take your time with yours; I'll keep the conversation going when it arrives, even if neither of us sounds casual.

reason: Make A direct the exchange while reducing B exposure and then accepting B reversal of speaking order, so the request for a trust risk is reciprocal.
